_README: Differences Phase 1 makes on purpose, between docs/parity-baseline/ (the live
hand-rolled stack) and cdk synth. Checked by scripts/check-parity.py.
Keep this SHORT. Every entry is something the CDK stack does differently from
what is running today, and each one should be defensible out loud. An entry
added to make the check go green is the failure this gate exists to prevent.
Not listed here, because they are not differences: resource names in the dev
stage (different by design) and CloudFormation logical IDs (an artefact of
CDK, not of the deployed resource).

logs.RetentionInDays.reason: The live log group never expires; CDK sets 1 month. The one deliberate difference in Phase 1. A poller logging every 15 minutes with no retention grows forever and bills forever, and nothing reads a greyBot log older than a few days. RETAIN on the group itself, so the port cannot delete existing logs.
